summary.headline: Planetary Combination Delineations
summary.text: Astrological delineations of planetary combinations involving Hermes, the Sun, Moon, Aphrodite, and Ares, describing their effects on character, reputation, learning, wealth, relationships, occupations, and financial misconduct.
